versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of Flesh Renderer (vn-fullwrite) for the "viết full" task
- Transforms structured beats into visceral in-character prose with strict POV filtering
- Integrates sensory vocabulary from vn-lexicon and world detail from vn-lorefilter
- Enforces a no-narrator, strictly embodied prose style anchored to each character’s immediate sensory experience
- Includes canonical rules for vocabulary rotation, sensory priority, memory fragmentation, and soundscape integration for immersive scene rendering
